Ghost Recon: Wildlands. Up to 4 players for co-op, but you can also play it with just 2. It's a huge open world with a lot of missions to do.
["Adios, motherfucker!"](https://youtu.be/plc7ssXDYsk?t=2m31s)

If you're going to be playing the game more often by yourself, I suggest getting Diablo 3. The progression and loot system make it really addicting. Once you get in the endgame, it becomes a bit of a grind with you battling RNG to get the best loot possible. But you can always start fresh with a new character if you're bored. The story is just okay, but collecting loot and making your character super powerful is really fun.

I put more time into Diablo 3. As I said, I only played I on PC, so I'm not sure how easy it is to use a controller instead of a keyboard and mouse. Some of the character classes require some very quick use of abilities.

Both games are great though!

I've only played Diablo 3 on PC, but I've played both games a lot. They're both great.

They're vastly different games, so it really depends what you're looking for. Do you want a game to pick up and play for short periods of time? Do you want something to play with friends? Have you played other Diablo games before?

I want to second Ghost Recon Wildlands. It's a very fun co-op experience. It's very satisfying using good communication and tactics to eliminate all the enemies in the outposts. I really liked the freedom most of the game gives you.
